name: iwac-mcp-server
description: Read-only access to the Islam West Africa Collection via Hugging Face datasets.
long_description:
Search and analyse the Islam West Africa Collection (IWAC) on Islam and Muslims in Benin, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Niger, Nigeria and Togo: ~16,700 newspaper articles (1961 to today, each with an AI abstract), 1,500 Islamic publications (searchable by keyword, subject, series and table of contents), 5,000 authority records (persons, places, organisations, events, subjects), ~1,800 audiovisual items, 860+ academic references, archival documents and fieldwork photographs. All matching is accent- and case-insensitive, and every result links to its canonical record on islam.zmo.de.

Beyond search and item reading, the tools describe whole selections: coverage over time (Gregorian or Islamic calendar, with normalised shares), LDA topics, subject, place and byline rankings, co-occurrence, a place map, lexical metrics, an embedding scatter and nearest neighbours for spotting reprints. A research workbench adds keyword-in-context reading, coverage heatmaps, two-selection comparison and CSL-JSON/BibTeX exports with dataset provenance. In hosts that support MCP Apps, fourteen tools render as interactive charts.

AI sentiment (polarity, centrality, subjectivity) comes from five independent models (gpt-5-6-luna, mistral-small-2603, deepseek-v4-flash-0731, gemma-4-31b-it and qwen3-8-27b) plus their precomputed majority, with inter-model agreement and kappa reported alongside. It covers the ~12,300 articles the enrichment pass has reached; the newest arrivals are not scored yet.

**No API key is required.** Four semantic-search tools find articles, publications, academic references and photographs by meaning (for photographs, describe what the image shows). They run EmbeddingGemma 2, the model the corpus was embedded with, on your machine, so no query leaves your computer. The first semantic search downloads the model once (~350 MB).

On first use the server downloads ~265 MB of parquet data from Hugging Face into a local cache. The public dataset carries full OCR text only where the item is public on islam.zmo.de (under half of the articles, most publications); titles, subjects and AI abstracts remain searchable for every item.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Cross-subset search across IWAC articles, publications, documents, references, index records, audiovisual materials, and photographs. Two-phase: curated metadata first, full OCR only when needed. Returns namespaced ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one IWAC item by a namespaced id returned from search, including canonical URL, text, category, and metadata.

tools.name: explore_corpus
tools.description: Research workbench over one selection: source reading, keyword-in-context concordance, source-by-year coverage, two-selection comparison, publication-country vs mentioned-place attention, authority aliases, and paginated manifest, CSL-JSON and BibTeX exports with dataset provenance. Renders as an interactive workbench in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search newspaper articles by French keyword (title, OCR, French and English AI abstracts), country, newspaper, subject, Gregorian date range, or Islamic (Hijri) month and year.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get full metadata, AI abstract, sentiment, and OCR text for a specific article, in 25k-character parts or as excerpts around a keyword.

tools.name: semantic_search_articles
tools.description: Semantic similarity search over article title + full text, in any language. Runs locally; no API key.

tools.name: search_by_sentiment
tools.description: Filter articles by gpt-5-6-luna polarity, centrality and subjectivity labels, or keep only the articles the five-model panel split on (disputed).

tools.name: get_sentiment_distribution
tools.description: Aggregate AI sentiment over a filtered selection, for one of the five models, all five side by side with their coverage and agreement (pairwise Cohen's and weighted kappa), or the panel's precomputed majority. Renders as interactive donut charts in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: search_index
tools.description: Search the authority index (persons, places, organisations, events, subjects).

tools.name: get_index_entry
tools.description: Get full details of an index entry.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: List subject terms ranked by frequency.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List locations from the index, ranked by frequency. The optional country filter selects places mentioned in that country's records (not places located there).

tools.name: list_persons
tools.description: List persons from the index, ranked by frequency. The optional country filter selects persons mentioned in that country's records.

tools.name: get_collection_stats
tools.description: Overall stats for all seven IWAC subsets, including how much of each carries searchable full text (fulltext_coverage). Renders as an interactive treemap with full-text coverage gauges in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_newspaper_stats
tools.description: Per-newspaper article counts and date ranges. Renders as an interactive ranked bar chart in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_country_comparison
tools.description: Compare article counts and sentiment across countries. Renders as interactive comparison charts in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_temporal_distribution
tools.description: Coverage over time: counts of matching items per Gregorian or Hijri year or month, or pooled into the twelve lunar months, optionally grouped by country or newspaper and normalised into shares with explicit denominators. Renders as an interactive chart in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_topic_distribution
tools.description: How a filtered set distributes across the precomputed LDA topics (30 for articles, 33 for references), optionally over time, with unclassified items disclosed. Renders as an interactive treemap and stacked timeline in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_field_distribution
tools.description: Rank the values of one multi-valued field (subject, spatial, author, language, newspaper, country) across a filtered set of articles, publications or references, optionally with the per-year share of items carrying a value. Renders as an interactive ranking in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_cooccurrence
tools.description: How often the top values of a multi-valued field appear on the same item: a subject or place co-mention matrix. Renders as an interactive heatmap in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_place_distribution
tools.description: Places named by a filtered set, joined to the index's geocoded authority records, with publication countries kept apart from mentioned places and missing geocodes counted. Renders as an interactive map of West Africa in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_semantic_map
tools.description: A 2-D PCA scatter of a sample of a filtered set, projected from the stored 768-dimension EmbeddingGemma 2 vectors, with the explained-variance share. Needs no API key or model download. Renders as an interactive scatter in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_similar_items
tools.description: The items nearest to a given one in meaning, by cosine similarity over the stored embeddings: candidates for reprinted or rewritten stories. For articles and documents the first ten are the dataset's published neighbours, the list islam.zmo.de shows. Renders as an interactive similarity chart in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_lexical_metrics
tools.description: Text length, lexical richness (MATTR) and French readability of the press by year, newspaper or country, from precomputed metrics. Renders as interactive charts in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search Islamic publications (periodical issues, books) by French keyword (title, subject, table of contents, OCR), series, subject, country, year, or Islamic (Hijri) month and year.

tools.name: list_periodicals
tools.description: List the periodical/series titles in the publications subset, with issue counts and year ranges. Renders as an interactive runs gantt in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_publication_fulltext
tools.description: Retrieve the full OCR text of a publication in 25k-character parts, or capped excerpts around a keyword.

tools.name: semantic_search_publications
tools.description: Semantic similarity search over publication tables of contents (~40% of issues), in any language. Runs locally; no API key.

tools.name: search_references
tools.description: Search multilingual academic references (journal articles, chapters, theses, books, reports) by title/abstract keyword, author, French metadata labels, country, language, and year; returns an abstract snippet.

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Get the full bibliographic record for a reference, including the complete abstract, DOI, subjects, and host-work details.

tools.name: semantic_search_references
tools.description: Semantic similarity search over academic references by title + abstract, across languages. Runs locally; no API key.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search the archival-documents subset (26 items: association reports, flyers, project documents, mostly Burkina Faso) with French keywords.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get full metadata, AI description, and OCR text for an archival document.

tools.name: search_audiovisual
tools.description: Search audiovisual materials by keyword, description, transcription and metadata, including the publishing channel and source type (francophone web video from Burkina Faso, Togo and Benin; deposited Nigerian Hausa/Arabic recordings).

tools.name: get_audiovisual
tools.description: Get full metadata, description, duration, rights, transcription (where one exists) and the item's links for a specific audiovisual record: the IWAC page plus either a watch URL or a media file.

tools.name: list_audiovisual
tools.description: List audiovisual materials, newest first, filterable by country, publishing channel or source type (francophone web video from Burkina Faso, Togo and Benin; deposited Nigerian Hausa/Arabic recordings).

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search the 30 fieldwork photographs by keyword, country, subject, place, photographer, and date. Returns image URLs and coordinates.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get full metadata, coordinates, IIIF manifest, and full-resolution image URL for a specific photograph.

tools.name: semantic_search_images
tools.description: Cross-modal search: find photographs by describing what they show, ranked against an embedding of the image itself. Runs locally; no API key.

cache_dir.title: Dataset cache directory
cache_dir.description: Where to store the downloaded IWAC parquet files (~265 MB on first run). Leave default to use your home directory.

semantic_search_enabled.title: Semantic search
semantic_search_enabled.description: Four tools that find articles, publications, references and photographs by meaning rather than keywords. They run locally without an API key; the first search downloads the model once (~350 MB). Turn off to skip that download.

private_dataset.title: Use private full dataset
private_dataset.description: Use the private full mirror with unmasked OCR. Requires an authorized Hugging Face token. Restart after changing.

hf_token.title: Hugging Face token (private dataset only)
hf_token.description: Fine-grained read access to fmadore/islam-west-africa-collection-full. Not needed for public data.
